originalTitle: Watch: Moment opposition MP throws eggs at Kosovo's acting PM
summary: Lawmakers and police officers had to intervene after Alliance party MP Time Kadrijaj hurled at least four eggs towards Kosovo's acting prime minister Albin Kurti.
content:
An opposition MP, Time Kadrijaj, threw eggs at Kosovo's acting Prime Minister Albin Kurti during a plenary session on Saturday.

The Alliance party MP hurled at least four eggs in Kurti's direction before lawmakers and police officers intervened.

Chaos unfolded after Kurti told Parliament he needed more time to hold talks with other parties before proposing a candidate for speaker following the June snap election.
chineseTitle: 观看：反对派议员向科索沃代理总理扔鸡蛋的时刻
chineseSummary: 在联盟党议员泰姆·卡德里亚吉向科索沃代理总理阿尔宾·库尔蒂投掷至少四个鸡蛋后，立法者和警察不得不进行干预。
chineseContent:
反对派议员泰姆·卡德里亚伊 (Time Kadrijaj) 在周六的全体会议上向科索沃代理总理阿尔宾·库尔蒂扔鸡蛋。

在立法者和警察介入之前，联盟党议员向库尔蒂的方向投掷了至少四个鸡蛋。

库尔蒂告诉议会，他需要更多时间与其他政党举行会谈，然后在 6 月提前选举后提出议长候选人，随后出现了混乱。
whyItMatters: 这条信息属于全球新闻信号，适合用于观察外部环境、政策变化、地缘风险和市场情绪。
